source: WHO Weekly Epidemiological Record 66(31), 2 August 1991 - Diseases subject to the Regulations: notifications received 26 July-1 August 1991 (via Wayback, whqlibdoc)
processing_notes: Source states: '[DISEASES SUBJECT TO THE REGULATIONS - Notifications received from 26 July to 1 August 1991; Cholera, Africa; columns C, D] Liberia - Libéria ...-30.VI 68 26' - interpreted as 68 sCh cases, 26 deaths. Interpreted as 68 sCh cases and 26 deaths notified by Liberia to WHO for a period ending 30 June 1991; the start of the period is printed as '...' (the table legend uses '...' for 'data not yet received'), so TL is set to 1 January 1991 because WHO's annual summary counts Liberia's notifications in 1991 (132 cases, 40 deaths for the year, JHU 1991) - the count could include cases from late 1990 (Barth 1991 describes a Monrovia cholera ward from mid-1990), hence confidence 0.6. CFR 38% is extreme but consistent with the annual 30% (40/132) and with war-time Monrovia, where 'Only soldiers received intravenous therapy, so cholera patients were not rehydrated' (Barth 1991, metadata 22): humanitarian/conflict context, flagged for review rather than rejected. Sub-period of the JHU 1991 annual row - do not sum with it. National total - includes provinces not individually listed. First official WHO notification from Liberia after the 1990 non-report (WER 66(19) 'Cholera in 1990' has no Liberia entry). Regional context (same table): Ghana 220/6, Niger 1 202/87, Chad 994/109; Cote d'Ivoire 604 cases in 1991 (WHO). Agent 3 batch 11 Q17. [AGENT 3 REVISION 2026-10-02] PERIOD CORROBORATED (Agent 3 batch 12 Q19): Liberia's second 1991 notification, WER 66(43), 25 Oct 1991, p. 320 ('Liberia - Liberia 1.VII-30.IX 64 14', row 1265, metadata 173), plus this row's 68/26 equals exactly WHO's 1991 annual total for Liberia (132 cases, 40 deaths; JHU 1991 annual row). The '...-30.VI' notification therefore covers calendar-1991 cases only (no late-1990 carry-in is needed to reach the annual figure), supporting TL = 1991-01-01. Confidence 0.6 -> 0.7 (the 0.7 cap applies because CFR > 15%). Do not sum rows 1264 and 1265 with the JHU 1991 annual row. (reason: Agent 3 batch 12 Q19: WER 66(43) Q3 1991 notification makes rows 1264+1265 sum exactly to WHO 1991 annual)
